metadata.description: Right-click cycles tile marks; left-button release opens an unopened tile or clears a question mark. Escape quits. R is an added full-session restart fallback. Source face-click restart and drag cancellation remain unresolved.

unresolved.reason: The source restarts only after a primary-button press and release both on the face. This backend's Input bindings cannot filter for scene:face or require a same-target press and release. An unfiltered mouse-release restart would also restart on board clicks. R provides full-session restart but does not preserve the clickable face control.

The source cancels a tile click when the primary-button release addresses a different tile from the press. Input bindings cannot compare the two rule coordinates. Scene pressed feedback reverts visually but cannot prevent a release binding from attempting a Rule action.

metadata.title: Pygame Minesweeper
metadata.description: The launcher starts a 10×10 game with ten mines. Right-click cycles unopened tiles through flag, question mark, and unopened. Left-click clears a question mark or opens a tile. The first opening relocates mines out of its surrounding area; opening a mine loses, and opening all safe tiles wins.

variables.name: Adjacent mine count, or 9 for a mine
0 unopened, 1 flagged, 2 questioned, 3 opened, 4 detonated, 5 incorrect flag, 6 exposed mine
Tiles opened by the core board
Timer ticks within the current second
Elapsed whole seconds, frozen at game end

actions.name: Left-click a question mark without opening the tile

systems.name: Advance the first-opening timer until win or loss

invariants.name: Flag count stays within board bounds
Exactly ten mines remain after relocation

assumptions: The launcher forces basic difficulty, so this Rule topology is fixed at 10×10.
The displayed timer is approximated by 60 simulation ticks per second rather than sampling wall-clock time.
Mine cells use 9 in the count grid; safe cells have at most eight neighboring mines.
Flood opening follows the core board's unopened tiles: a flag or question mark in a zero region can be opened without decrementing the UI's flag counter.

unresolved.reason: This backend exposes authoritative state to local clients. Covered mines can be concealed visually, but secure hidden observations for agents or remote clients are unavailable.
The source saves winning times to a persistent JSON high-score file; Rule commands cannot perform filesystem persistence. This does not affect the executable board rules.
The source retries random row-and-column pairs. Shuffling sites and selecting the first eligible destination preserves the uniform destination distribution but not the exact random-number sequence.
